children: R Systems International Limited (RSI), a global leader in digital product engineering, today announced that it has been recognized as a
Major Contender in Everest Group’s Healthcare Provider IT Services for Mid-market PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026

The assessment comes at a time when mid-market healthcare providers are increasingly prioritizing technology investments to accelerate technology modernization to address rising costs, fragmented systems, revenue leakage, and evolving expectations for patient experience. As investment priorities shift toward measurable outcomes, demand is growing for AI-led product development lifecycle, cloud modernization, interoperability, and data-driven solutions that deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.

AI-native IP-led healthcare accelerators such as RSI Codex and iRCM support intelligent automation across clinical and administrative workflows, helping providers streamline operations, improve revenue cycle performance, and enhance patient experiences.

Strong capabilities across digital product engineering, AI-driven product development lifecycle (AI PDLC), platform modernization, custom application development, and healthcare systems integration, enabling faster development of tailored applications to capture and manage patient data.

“Rising labor costs, workforce shortages, and margin pressures are driving mid-market healthcare providers to prioritize IT investments in EHR implementation and managed services, data and cloud modernization, and cybersecurity to improve productivity and optimize costs. R Systems has been recognized as a Major Contender in Everest Group's Healthcare Provider IT Services for Mid-market PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026, supported by its application services capabilities across platform modernization, healthcare system integration, and custom application development for patient data management. Its healthcare-specific frameworks, such as Codex for AI-powered medical coding and iRCM for revenue cycle automation, along with its healthcare domain knowledge and flexible client engagement approach, have strengthened its presence in the mid-market healthcare IT services segment,” said Priya Sahni, Vice President at Everest Group.

Beyond these capabilities, RSI continues to advance AI-led product engineering through EXIQO, RSI’s AI studio and has also demonstrated the impact of AI in addressing critical healthcare challenges. The company also recently received an industry award for its application of AI in healthcare, recognizing a client solution supporting early disease detection and improved interoperability.

“In healthcare, the true value of technology lies in the time it gives back to clinicians, the complexity it removes from care delivery, and the difference it makes to patients. AI is democratizing access, enabling mid-market providers to accelerate innovation, improve efficiency, and deliver better patient outcomes. At R Systems, our focus is on making this potential a reality by helping providers put AI to work where it matters most. Our recognition by Everest Group reinforces our commitment to helping providers get more value from their technology investments,” said Sanjeev Dhawan, Vice President – Healthcare, R Systems.

Everest Group is a leading global research firm helping business leaders make confident decisions. Everest Group's PEAK Matrix® assessments provide the analysis and insights enterprises need to make critical selection decisions about global services providers, locations, and products and solutions within various market segments. Likewise, providers of these services, products, and solutions look to the PEAK Matrix® to gauge and calibrate their offerings against others in the industry or market. Find further details and in-depth content at www.everestgrp.com.

RSI is a trusted software engineering and digital transformation services partner to global enterprises navigating technological change. RSI enables technology companies, SaaS platforms, and enterprises to solve real-world challenges, accelerate time to market, and scale AI-driven innovation across the full software development lifecycle and business automation. Powered by a culture of curiosity and continuous learning, RSI’s global engineering teams combine deep technical expertise with engineering velocity and disciplined delivery, helping clients ship faster, modernize smarter, and build with confidence. With proven AI fluency at every layer of the technology stack, RSI helps clients not only adopt AI, but operationalize it, embedding intelligence into products, platforms, and processes. RSI’s AI Studio, EXIQO, brings together AIEV-trained engineers (RSI’s proficiency-based certification framework across AI, to drive engineering velocity) and the enterprise-ready Optima AI platform to orchestrate and deliver AI-led transformation across business operations, the SDLC, and legacy modernization. Committed to responsible technology and sustainable value creation, RSI works closely with clients and partners to build AI first ecosystems, driving long-term growth. https://www.rsystems.com/
